unsigned char + > 1 gives the unsigned jbe-exit shape (80 38 01 cmp byte [eax],1 / 77 f5 ja); the loop's byte reload 80 38 after the store falls out of CL's no-aliasing model for free since d and s may alias.
no sites: pure code chunk, 32 B incl. 2 B 8bff ILINK pad.

recipe: void __fastcall w30c_strsqueez(char *s) — EXACT no maps/patches; in-place squeeze of '~' chars: d=s; do { c=*s; if (c!='~') *d++=c; } while (*s != 0 && (s++, 1)); — the comma-spelling is load-bearing: it re-reads *s for the loop condition (84 d2 test dl — aliasing reload, since d may clobber s) and puts the inc ecx AFTER the test (FA: test dl,dl / 74 03 / 41 inc ecx / eb ed jmp); the plain while(*s++) spelling hoists inc before the test and mismatches.
self jmp eb ed targets chunk offset 0x2 = the body head (8b 10 mov dl,[ecx]) — CL emits the same back-edge with the same displacement; entry falls through mov eax,ecx.
fastcall single pointer arg in ecx; FPO params=0 cbProlog=0.
